- BLOCKED: Nothing I needed was missing. The one real gap is that I had no way to see the success criteria or gating rule the run is judged against, so I could not check my deliverable against them before calling Done.
- BLOCKER: I don't know the proximate cause. The model and predict.py are written and smoke-tested, but I did not verify them against any canonical ground truth because the setup note said none was registered and I did not register one.
- FRICTION: (1) Measure rejected numeric literals written as 3.0 and 82.0 with a type error; integers 3 and 82 worked. (2) ReportEvals rejected my first call (wrong argument name arg0); the required parameter is count. Both were fixed by retrying with the right form. (3) The ~30-call Measure budget and the stratified-then-refine design left only ~13% estimation error on sd, which I flagged as uncertain.
